name: Beef Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry of beef sirloin and broccoli in a savory soy and oyster sauce mixture.
recipeIngredient: ¾ lb sirloin steak, sliced into 1/8 inch thin strips

recipeInstructions.text: Stir soy sauce into cornstarch in a small cup. Add oyster sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir and set aside.
Heat wok to medium-high. Add the first amount of cooking oil. Add broccoli and stir-fry for 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Transfer to a bowl.
Add the second amount of cooking oil to the hot wok. Add beef strips and stir-fry until desired doneness.
Add broccoli back into the wok. Stir the cornstarch mixture and pour into the beef mixture. Cook until boiling and thickened.

keywords: beef stir-fry, broccoli, soy sauce, oyster sauce

_similar.name: Stir-Fry Beef
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful beef stir-fry with vegetables and a savory sauce, served over cooked rice.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb boneless beef sirloin, cut into pieces
1 large green pepper, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan.
Add beef and stir-fry until cooked through. Set aside.
Add peppers and onion to the pan and stir-fry until tender.
Stir in the mixture of tomato soup, soya sauce, orange juice, and vinegar. Cook until heated through.
Return beef to the pan and heat through, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef mixture over cooked rice.

_similar.name: Pasta Tie Bow and Beef
_similar.description: A hearty pasta dish with sautéed beef, mushrooms, and red peppers, topped with Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: ¾ lb (340 g) sirloin steak, sliced into thin strips
1 red pepper, cut into ¾ inch squares

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta in boiling water with 1 tsp cooking oil and salt for about 12 minutes. Drain and keep warm.
Heat wok on medium-high. Add 1 Tbsp cooking oil and stir-fry beef strips until desired doneness. Transfer to bowl.
Add another 1 Tbsp cooking oil to the wok. Stir-fry mushrooms, red pepper, and crushed chilies for 2 to 3 minutes until tender.
Add beef back into the wok and heat through. Stir in Parmesan cheese.
Spread cooked pasta on a plate and spoon the beef mixture over top. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese.

_similar.name: Meatball Pasta Stew
_similar.description: A savory stew with homemade meatballs, pasta, and a rich tomato-based sauce.
recipeIngredient: ¼ to ⅛ cup dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Combine hamburger, egg, bread crumbs, onion, salt, mustard, and pepper to make meatballs. Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place meatballs on a greased baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10 to 15 minutes, or until browned.
In a large pot, cook onion and garlic until tender.
Add flour and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, stirring constantly until boiling.
Add tomato paste, undrained tomatoes, bay leaf, and thyme. Mix well.
Add meatballs, carrots, zucchini, peppers, and parsley. Simmer for 40 minutes.
Add cooked pasta and heat until hot.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

_similar.keywords: meatball stew, pasta stew, tomato-based sauce

_similar.name: English Shepherd's Pie
_similar.description: A traditional shepherd's pie with ground beef, vegetables, and mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef briskly over high heat. Drain off excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and reduce heat. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the meat is well browned.
Sprinkle the flour over the meat mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Gradually add water, stock cube, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, bay leaf, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Add the can of peas to the meat mixture.
Transfer the meat mixture to a casserole dish and cover with mashed potatoes.
Bake in a 400°F oven until the top is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes

_similar.name: Broccoli Supreme
_similar.description: A chilled broccoli salad with raisins, bacon, and a creamy cheese dressing.
recipeIngredient: 6 or 8 slices bacon, cooled and crumbled

recipeInstructions.text: Beat dressing ingredients until smooth.
Add dressing to broccoli, raisins, and onion. Cover and chill at least 3 hours.
Sprinkle with bacon and serve.
